intro.title: Guess what we've been up to.

badge-detail.title: Your Achievements, Up Close
badge-detail.body: Tap any badge to see what you earned it for and what reward it unlocked.

persistent-note.title: Notes That Stay
persistent-note.body: Toggle Persistent Note to keep a note alive even after you turn it into a task.

time-picker.title: Smoother Time Picking
time-picker.body: Hours and minutes now scroll continuously — no more snapping back when you reach the ends.

recurring-subtasks.title: Break Down Repeating Tasks
recurring-subtasks.body: From any recurring task's detail page, ask the AI to split it into subtasks — even for just that one instance.

widget.title: Your Tasks on Your Home Screen
widget.body: Add the Blotz widget to see today's tasks at a glance — no need to open the app.

firework.title: A Little Celebration Every Time
firework.body: Complete a task and watch the confetti fly. Subtasks get a smaller burst — every win counts.
